item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: Implement ticket TT-104 exactly as written in BACKLOG.md at the repository root (section "TT-104: Undo"), following its acceptance criteria exactly. Scope: tasktracker/store.py, adding TaskStore.undo() that reverts the most recent not-yet-undone add, complete or delete (LIFO across all three kinds): undoing add removes the task; undoing complete reopens it; undoing delete restores it exactly under the same id; ids are never reused; with nothing to undo raise NothingToUndo (defined in tasktracker.store); failed operations are not recorded. Add new unit tests for it. Keep existing tests passing with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. Use only the Python standard library. Commit this ticket as one commit with a clear message; do not push. Do not change other tickets' files (dates.py, export.py, search.py) beyond what this ticket needs. Follow the repository's style and the maintainability rules: short functions, explicit validation, no silent fallback.

pr.body: Approach: TaskStore keeps an in-memory undo log; each successful add, complete or delete appends an entry after validation, so failed operations are not recorded. undo() pops the last entry. Delete entries store a copy of the task (dataclasses.replace with a copied tags list). Complete entries store the prior status, which is open in normal use. Ids are never reused. Files: tasktracker/store.py, tests/test_undo.py (new). Checks: unittest discover, 15 OK (4 existing, 11 new). Review: one reviewer, pass, one non-blocking follow-up: the undo log is unbounded for the store's lifetime. Assumption: undoing a complete on an already-done task keeps it done (restores prior status) rather than reopening it.
pr.summary: Made undo happen. Now can revert the latest add, complete or delete (LIFO), raising NothingToUndo when empty. Before: no undo, now: undo reverts add (removes task), complete (restores prior status) and delete (restores same id).
